   726	///   JSON field is rejected loudly at parse time.
   727	#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
   728	#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
   729	pub struct CellRecord {
   730	    pub row: u32,
   731	    pub col: u32,
   732	    pub value: CellWireValue,
   733	    /// Formula source (without leading `=`). Phase 1 W5-9. Omitted from JSON when None.
   734	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   735	    pub formula: Option<String>,
   736	}
   737	
   738	// (Tier D2 (2026-05-19): `CellWireValue`, `error_to_canonical_text`,
   739	//  `parse_canonical_error_text`, and the `impl` blocks moved to
   740	//  `ql_oplog::wire`. Re-exported via `ql_io::lib.rs` for backwards
   741	//  compat. The `to_value()` return type is now `WireDecodeError`,
   742	//  which `QbookError` wraps via a `#[from]` impl below.)
   743	
   744	/// Save a `Workbook` to `path` (a `.qbook/` directory). **Crash-safe atomic save**
   745	/// per the Phase 2A.8 megaudit H2 closure:
   746	///
   747	/// 1. Write the new workbook to `<path>.tmp-save-<random>`.
   748	/// 2. If `path` already exists, rename it to `<path>.bak-<random>`.
   749	/// 3. Rename the temp directory into `path`.
   750	/// 4. Best-effort remove the backup; on failure, log a warning to stderr but
   751	///    DO NOT silently swallow (megaudit M8). The next `load_workbook` will
   752	///    detect the orphan via `recover_from_crashed_save` and clean it up.
   753	///
   754	/// **Invariant**: between any two adjacent steps, at least one of `path` or
   755	/// `<path>.bak-<random>` contains a complete valid workbook. A crash at any
   756	/// instant leaves a recoverable on-disk state.
   757	///
   758	/// Cross-filesystem note: the temp and backup paths are *siblings* of the
   759	/// target, sharing its parent directory. POSIX `rename(2)` is atomic within a
   760	/// single filesystem; the sibling-only design preserves that property.
   761	pub fn save_workbook(wb: &Workbook, name: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<(), QbookError> {
   762	    save_workbook_extending(wb, name, path, |_| Ok(()))
   763	}
   764	
   765	/// Phase 2A.3.c (2026-05-12): closure-based extension primitive. Same atomic-save
   766	/// protocol as `save_workbook`, with an additional hook (`extend`) that fires
   767	/// AFTER `write_workbook_to_dir` populates the temp directory but BEFORE the
   768	/// atomic `rename(temp → target)`. Used by `ql_oplog::save_workbook_with_oplog`
   769	/// to write `oplog.bin` as a sidecar — it rides the same atomic rename and
   770	/// recovers via the same crash-rollback path.
   771	///
   772	/// The closure receives the temp directory path. It can `fs::write` arbitrary
   773	/// files into it. The atomic-save invariant still holds: at every step
   774	/// boundary, at least one of {target, `<target>.bak-<random>`} contains a
   775	/// complete valid workbook + any sidecars the closure wrote.
   776	///
   777	/// Closure failure cleans up the temp directory and propagates the error —
   778	/// same semantics as a `write_workbook_to_dir` failure.
   779	///
   780	/// Public `save_workbook` is a thin wrapper that calls this with a no-op
   781	/// closure; callers without sidecars should keep using `save_workbook`.
   782	pub fn save_workbook_extending<F>(
   783	    wb: &Workbook,
   784	    name: &str,
   785	    path: &Path,
   786	    extend: F,
   787	) -> Result<(), QbookError>
   788	where
   789	    F: FnOnce(&Path) -> Result<(), QbookError>,
   790	{
   791	    let paths = make_save_paths(path)?;
   792	
   793	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H5: refuse to save into a path that exists
   794	    // but is NOT a directory. `path.exists() && !path.is_dir()` means a
   795	    // regular file (or symlink, FIFO, etc.) is sitting where the workbook
   796	    // directory should be. The previous code would have happily renamed
   797	    // that file to `<base>.bak-<suffix>`, then installed our directory in
   798	    // its place — the user's original file becomes an orphan no one will
   799	    // ever find (recovery would try `remove_dir_all` on it and fail with
   800	    // `NotADirectory`). Loud refusal is the right answer.
   801	    if path.exists() && !path.is_dir() {
   802	        return Err(QbookError::InvalidPath {
   803	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
   804	            reason: "target exists but is not a directory",
   805	        });
   806	    }
   807	
   808	    // Step 1: write everything to the temp dir. If this fails, the original
   809	    // target (if any) is untouched and we clean up the partial temp.
   810	    if let Err(e) = write_workbook_to_dir(wb, name, &paths.temp) {
   811	        if let Err(cleanup_err) = fs::remove_dir_all(&paths.temp) {
   812	            // The original save error is what the caller wants; the cleanup
   813	            // failure goes to stderr per the M8 audit (don't silence).
   814	            eprintln!(
   815	                "warning: failed to clean partial temp directory {:?} after save error: {cleanup_err}",
   816	                paths.temp
   817	            );
   818	        }
   819	        return Err(e);
   820	    }
   821	
   822	    // Phase 2A.3.c: extension hook fires after the engine has finished
   823	    // populating the temp dir (envelope + sheets + marker), but before the
   824	    // atomic rename. Sidecars written here become part of the all-or-nothing
   825	    // visibility guarantee.
   826	    if let Err(e) = extend(&paths.temp) {
   827	        if let Err(cleanup_err) = fs::remove_dir_all(&paths.temp) {
   828	            eprintln!(
   829	                "warning: failed to clean partial temp directory {:?} after extend error: {cleanup_err}",
   830	                paths.temp
   831	            );
   832	        }
   833	        return Err(e);
   834	    }
   835	
   836	    // Step 2: if target exists, move it aside (NOT remove). After this, the
   837	    // old state is at `.bak-<random>` and the target is missing.
   838	    let had_existing = path.exists();
   839	    if had_existing {
   840	        fs::rename(path, &paths.backup)?;
   841	    }
   842	
   843	    // Step 3: install the new state at the target. If this fails after step 2,
   844	    // we have `.bak-<random>` only and no target — recovery on next load will
   845	    // roll back. To avoid leaving the temp dir orphaned in that case, attempt
   846	    // a rollback ourselves before returning.
   847	    if let Err(install_err) = fs::rename(&paths.temp, path) {
   848	        // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 M5: when install fails AND restore also
   849	        // fails, surface a compound error (was: silently `eprintln!`ed the
   850	        // restore failure and returned only the install error).
   851	        let restore_err: Option<std::io::Error> = if had_existing {
   852	            fs::rename(&paths.backup, path).err()
   853	        } else {
   854	            None
   855	        };
   856	        // The temp dir didn't move into place; try to clean it up.
   857	        if let Err(cleanup_err) = fs::remove_dir_all(&paths.temp) {
   858	            eprintln!(
   859	                "warning: failed to clean temp directory {:?} after rename failure: {cleanup_err}",
   860	                paths.temp
   861	            );
   862	        }
   863	        if let Some(restore_err) = restore_err {
   864	            // Both failed → compound user-visible error.
   865	            return Err(QbookError::AtomicSaveRollbackFailed {
   866	                backup_path: paths.backup.clone(),
   867	                install: install_err.to_string(),
   868	                restore: restore_err.to_string(),
   869	            });
   870	        }
   871	        // Restore succeeded (or no prior target existed): the user's prior
   872	        // workbook is intact at `path`. Return the install error so the
   873	        // caller knows the save itself failed.
   874	        return Err(QbookError::Io(install_err));
   875	    }
   876	
   877	    // Step 4: best-effort backup cleanup. On failure, log loudly — but the
   878	    // save itself succeeded, so we return Ok. `recover_from_crashed_save` on
   879	    // a future load will eventually clean up the orphan.
   880	    if had_existing {
   881	        if let Err(e) = fs::remove_dir_all(&paths.backup) {
   882	            eprintln!(
   883	                "warning: save succeeded but backup cleanup failed at {:?}: {e}",
   884	                paths.backup
   885	            );
   886	        }
   887	    }
   888	    Ok(())
   889	}
   890	
   891	/// Phase 2A.8 audit M10: each save uses a fresh, collision-resistant suffix so
   892	/// concurrent saves from two threads in the same process never share temp /
   893	/// backup paths. The suffix mixes wall-clock nanos, PID, and the calling
   894	/// thread's id — sufficient uniqueness for the IDE save-path workload without
   895	/// pulling in a random-source crate.
   896	fn save_session_suffix() -> String {
   897	    let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()
   898	        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   899	        .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)
   900	        .unwrap_or(0);
   901	    let pid = std::process::id() as u64;
   902	    // ThreadId formats as "ThreadId(N)" — hash via length + a fixed mixer to
   903	    // get a u64 contribution. Stable within a process.
   904	    let tid_str = format!("{:?}", std::thread::current().id());
   905	    let tid_hash = tid_str.bytes().fold(0u64, |acc, b| {
   906	        acc.wrapping_mul(0x100000001B3).wrapping_add(b as u64)
   907	    });
   908	    let mixed = nanos
   909	        .wrapping_mul(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)
   910	        .wrapping_add(pid.wrapping_mul(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9))
   911	        ^ tid_hash;
   912	    format!("{mixed:016x}")
   913	}
   914	
   915	/// Resolved temp + backup paths for one save invocation. Sharing the suffix
   916	/// between temp and backup lets `recover_from_crashed_save` link them
   917	/// unambiguously if a crash occurs mid-protocol.
   918	struct SavePaths {
   919	    temp: PathBuf,
   920	    backup: PathBuf,
   921	}
   922	
   923	/// Derive temp + backup sibling paths for `target`. Phase 2A.8 audit M9
   924	/// closure: degenerate paths (no parent, no file_name) error loudly via
   925	/// `QbookError::InvalidPath` rather than the prior `unwrap_or` silent fallback.
   926	fn make_save_paths(target: &Path) -> Result<SavePaths, QbookError> {
   927	    let parent = target.parent().ok_or_else(|| QbookError::InvalidPath {
   928	        path: target.to_path_buf(),
   929	        reason: "no parent directory",
   930	    })?;
   931	    let basename = target
   932	        .file_name()
   933	        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
   934	        .ok_or_else(|| QbookError::InvalidPath {
   935	            path: target.to_path_buf(),
   936	            reason: "no file name",
   937	        })?;
   938	    // Refuse to save into a target whose basename is itself a temp/backup name
   939	    // — that would let a path like `foo.bak-abc/` collide with our own
   940	    // backup-rename protocol. Phase 2A.8 conservative gate; the IDE shouldn't
   941	    // pick names like this, but a hostile caller could.
   942	    if basename.contains(".tmp-save-") || basename.contains(".bak-") {
   943	        return Err(QbookError::InvalidPath {
   944	            path: target.to_path_buf(),
   945	            reason: "basename collides with atomic-save protocol naming",
   946	        });
   947	    }
   948	    let suffix = save_session_suffix();
   949	    Ok(SavePaths {
   950	        temp: parent.join(format!("{basename}.tmp-save-{suffix}")),
   951	        backup: parent.join(format!("{basename}.bak-{suffix}")),
   952	    })
   953	}
   954	
   955	/// Phase 2A.8 audit H2 recovery protocol. Called at the top of
   956	/// `load_workbook`. Detects orphan `.bak-<random>` siblings of `target` and
   957	/// either rolls forward (target is intact, just clean up bak) or rolls back
   958	/// (target missing/invalid, rename bak → target).
   959	///
   960	/// If multiple `.bak-*` orphans exist (unlikely; would require multiple
   961	/// crashes across save sessions), we conservatively refuse to load and ask
   962	/// the caller to manually resolve. Returning an error here is safer than
   963	/// guessing which backup is "the right one."
   964	fn recover_from_crashed_save(target: &Path) -> Result<(), QbookError> {
   965	    let Some(parent) = target.parent() else {
   966	        return Ok(()); // No parent, nothing to scan.
   967	    };
   968	    let basename = match target.file_name() {
   969	        Some(s) => s.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
   970	        None => return Ok(()),
   971	    };
   972	    let bak_prefix = format!("{basename}.bak-");
   973	
   974	    // Scan the parent dir for orphan .bak-* siblings.
   975	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H1: ONLY consider directories that carry our
   976	    // atomic-save marker file (`is_engine_owned_backup`). A user-created
   977	    // sibling like `book.qbook.bak-2025-review` shares the filename prefix
   978	    // but lacks the marker — recovery leaves it alone.
   979	    let mut orphans: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
   980	    let read_dir = match fs::read_dir(parent) {
   981	        Ok(it) => it,
   982	        Err(_) => return Ok(()), // Parent unreadable; load will fail downstream with a clearer error.
   983	    };
   984	    for entry in read_dir.flatten() {
   985	        if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {
   986	            if name.starts_with(&bak_prefix) {
   987	                let p = entry.path();
   988	                if is_engine_owned_backup(&p) {
   989	                    orphans.push(p);
   990	                }
   991	                // Else: user-created sibling that just happens to match the
   992	                // `.bak-*` prefix. Not ours, don't touch.
   993	            }
   994	        }
   995	    }
   996	
   997	    if orphans.is_empty() {
   998	        return Ok(());
   999	    }
  1000	
  1001	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 M6: when the target is valid AND we have
  1002	    // multiple orphans, they're ALL stale (a valid target can only result
  1003	    // from a single most-recent successful save; any older `.bak-*` is from
  1004	    // a prior save whose step-4 cleanup never completed). Clean them all up
  1005	    // instead of refusing to load — accumulated `eprintln!` warnings from
  1006	    // repeated step-4 failures would otherwise create a permanent deadlock.
  1007	    if target_envelope_is_valid(target) {
  1008	        for bak in &orphans {
  1009	            if let Err(e) = fs::remove_dir_all(bak) {
  1010	                eprintln!(
  1011	                    "warning: load detected orphan backup {bak:?} but cleanup failed: {e}; \
  1012	                     target is valid, so load proceeds"
  1013	                );
  1014	            }
  1015	        }
  1016	        return Ok(());
  1017	    }
  1018	
  1019	    // Target is missing or invalid. We need to restore from a backup.
  1020	    // Multi-orphan case here IS ambiguous (we don't know which backup
  1021	    // matches the missing target); refuse and ask the user.
  1022	    if orphans.len() > 1 {
  1023	        return Err(QbookError::InvalidPath {
  1024	            path: target.to_path_buf(),
  1025	            reason: "target is missing/invalid AND multiple .bak-* siblings present; \
  1026	                     ambiguous crash recovery — resolve manually before loading",
  1027	        });
  1028	    }
  1029	    let bak = orphans.into_iter().next().expect("len == 1");
  1030	
  1031	    // Step 2 completed but step 3 didn't (or step 3 partially completed
  1032	    // and left an invalid target). Roll back: restore the old state.
  1033	    if target.exists() {
  1034	        if let Err(e) = fs::remove_dir_all(target) {
  1035	            return Err(QbookError::Io(e));
  1036	        }
  1037	    }
  1038	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 M4: concurrent loader race. Two loaders
  1039	    // seeing the same orphan can race here — one wins, the other sees
  1040	    // `NotFound` because the bak is already consumed. If we lose the
  1041	    // rename race, re-check whether the target is NOW valid (the other
  1042	    // loader's rename succeeded and installed it). Only return the I/O
  1043	    // error if the rollback genuinely failed.
  1044	    if let Err(rename_err) = fs::rename(&bak, target) {
  1045	        if target_envelope_is_valid(target) {
  1046	            // Another loader won the race and the rollback is already done.
  1047	            // We're good — proceed with load.
  1048	            return Ok(());
  1049	        }
  1050	        return Err(QbookError::Io(rename_err));
  1051	    }
  1052	    Ok(())
  1053	}
  1054	
  1055	/// Cheap envelope-validity check used by recovery. The full load is the real
  1056	/// validity test, but recovery needs a quick yes/no to decide forward vs
  1057	/// back. We check: directory exists, `workbook.toml` parses, every claimed
  1058	/// sheet JSONL file exists. We DO NOT parse JSONL line-by-line — that's the
  1059	/// load path's job.
  1060	fn target_envelope_is_valid(target: &Path) -> bool {
  1061	    if !target.is_dir() {
  1062	        return false;
  1063	    }
  1064	    let toml_path = target.join("workbook.toml");
  1065	    if !toml_path.is_file() {
  1066	        return false;
  1067	    }
  1068	    let toml_str = match fs::read_to_string(&toml_path) {
  1069	        Ok(s) => s,
  1070	        Err(_) => return false,
  1071	    };
  1072	    let envelope: WorkbookEnvelope = match toml::from_str(&toml_str) {
  1073	        Ok(e) => e,
  1074	        Err(_) => return false,
  1075	    };
  1076	    let sheets_dir = target.join("sheets");
  1077	    for sheet_env in &envelope.sheets {
  1078	        let sheet_path = sheets_dir.join(format!("{}.jsonl", sheet_env.id));
  1079	        if !sheet_path.is_file() {
  1080	            return false;
  1081	        }
  1082	    }
  1083	    true
  1084	}
  1085	
  1086	/// Inner write that populates `dir` with `workbook.toml` + `sheets/*.jsonl`. Used by
  1087	/// `save_workbook` against a temp dir; not a public surface (the atomic-save wrapper
  1088	/// is what callers want).
  1089	fn write_workbook_to_dir(wb: &Workbook, name: &str, dir: &Path) -> Result<(), QbookError> {
  1090	    fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
  1091	    let sheets_dir = dir.join("sheets");
  1092	    fs::create_dir_all(&sheets_dir)?;
  1093	
  1094	    // Build the envelope.
  1095	    let mut sheet_envelopes: Vec<SheetEnvelope> = Vec::new();
  1096	    for sheet_id in 0..(wb.sheet_count() as SheetId) {
  1097	        let sheet = wb.sheet(sheet_id).expect("sheet_count was wrong");
  1098	        let bounds = sheet.bounds();
  1099	        // **W5-81 (Phase 4.5.D part 5):** serialize the per-sheet cell-format
  1100	        // overlay if it has any entries. Sorted by (row, col) for diffability.
  1101	        let format_overlay = {
  1102	            let overlay = sheet.format_overlay();
  1103	            if overlay.is_empty() {
  1104	                None
  1105	            } else {
  1106	                let mut entries: Vec<FormatOverlayEntry> = overlay
  1107	                    .iter()
  1108	                    .map(|((r, c), fid)| FormatOverlayEntry {
  1109	                        row: r,
  1110	                        col: c,
  1111	                        id: fid.0,
  1112	                    })
  1113	                    .collect();
  1114	                entries.sort_by_key(|e| (e.row, e.col));
  1115	                Some(entries)
  1116	            }
  1117	        };
  1118	        sheet_envelopes.push(SheetEnvelope {
  1119	            id: sheet_id,
  1120	            name: sheet.name().to_owned(),
  1121	            chunk_rows: sheet_chunk_rows(sheet),
  1122	            row_extent: bounds.row_extent,
  1123	            col_extent: bounds.col_extent,
  1124	            format_overlay,
  1125	        });
  1126	    }
  1127	
  1128	    // Phase 2A.8: serialize the workbook's NameTable. Sorted ascending by
  1129	    // (scope, name) for deterministic on-disk diffs (workbook-scoped first
  1130	    // since `None < Some` under derive(Ord); then by name). Omitted (None)
  1131	    // when both workbook-scoped table AND every sheet's scoped_names table
  1132	    // are empty, so v1-reader compatibility round-trips cleanly for the
  1133	    // empty-names common case.
  1134	    //
  1135	    // **W5-92 (Phase 4.6.D):** collects workbook-scoped names first, then
  1136	    // sheet-scoped names from each sheet's `scoped_names` table. The
  1137	    // `scope` field on `NamedEntry` distinguishes the two; legacy v1-v4
  1138	    // readers emit only the workbook-scoped entries (no per-sheet names
  1139	    // existed pre-v5).
  1140	    let names_section = {
  1141	        let mut entries: Vec<NamedEntry> = Vec::new();
  1142	        for (name, target) in wb.names().iter() {
  1143	            entries.push(NamedEntry {
  1144	                name: name.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1145	                target: NamedTargetWire::from_target(target),
  1146	                scope: None,
  1147	            });
  1148	        }
  1149	        for sheet_id in 0..wb.sheet_count() as ql_types::SheetId {
  1150	            if let Some(sheet) = wb.sheet(sheet_id) {
  1151	                for (name, target) in sheet.scoped_names().iter() {
  1152	                    entries.push(NamedEntry {
  1153	                        name: name.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1154	                        target: NamedTargetWire::from_target(target),
  1155	                        scope: Some(sheet_id),
  1156	                    });
  1157	                }
  1158	            }
  1159	        }
  1160	        if entries.is_empty() {
  1161	            None
  1162	        } else {
  1163	            // Deterministic ordering: workbook-scoped (scope=None) entries
  1164	            // first, then sheet-scoped grouped by sheet id; within each
  1165	            // group, names sorted ascending.
  1166	            entries.sort_by(|a, b| a.scope.cmp(&b.scope).then(a.name.cmp(&b.name)));
  1167	            Some(NamesSection { entries })
  1168	        }
  1169	    };
  1170	
  1171	    // **W5-81 (Phase 4.5.D part 5):** serialize custom FormatTable entries
  1172	    // (id ≥ FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID). Built-ins are re-seeded from
  1173	    // `FormatTable::default()` on load and aren't persisted. None if the
  1174	    // table has no custom entries (typical for built-in-only workbooks).
  1175	    let formats_section = {
  1176	        let mut entries: Vec<FormatEntry> = wb
  1177	            .formats()
  1178	            .iter()
  1179	            .filter(|(id, _)| id.0 >= ql_storage::FIRST_CUSTOM_FORMAT_ID)
  1180	            .map(|(id, s)| FormatEntry {
  1181	                id: id.0,
  1182	                string: s.to_owned(),
  1183	            })
  1184	            .collect();
  1185	        if entries.is_empty() {
  1186	            None
  1187	        } else {
  1188	            entries.sort_by_key(|e| e.id);
  1189	            Some(FormatsSection { entries })
  1190	        }
  1191	    };
  1192	
  1193	    // **W5-123 (Phase 4.8.L):** serialize `TableTable` if non-empty.
  1194	    // Sorted ascending by canonical (uppercase) name for deterministic
  1195	    // diffs. Empty TableTable → `None` so v1-v5 readers don't see an
  1196	    // unexpected `[[tables]]` block that they'd misinterpret (the
  1197	    // schema-version gate already forces UnsupportedSchema for them,
  1198	    // but omitting on empty also keeps v6 TOML minimal for the common
  1199	    // "no tables yet" case).
  1200	    let tables_section = {
  1201	        let mut entries: Vec<TableEntry> = wb
  1202	            .tables()
  1203	            .iter()
  1204	            .map(|(_canon, meta)| TableEntry {
  1205	                name: meta.name.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1206	                display_name: meta.display_name.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1207	                sheet: meta.sheet,
  1208	                top_row: meta.top_row,
  1209	                top_col: meta.top_col,
  1210	                rows: meta.rows,
  1211	                cols: meta.cols,
  1212	                has_header: meta.has_header,
  1213	                has_totals: meta.has_totals,
  1214	                columns: meta
  1215	                    .columns
  1216	                    .iter()
  1217	                    .map(|c| TableColumnEntry {
  1218	                        id: c.id,
  1219	                        name: c.name.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1220	                        display: c.display.as_ref().to_owned(),
  1221	                        totals_function: c.totals_function.map(TotalsFunctionWire::from_runtime),
  1222	                    })
  1223	                    .collect(),
  1224	            })
  1225	            .collect();
  1226	        if entries.is_empty() {
  1227	            None
  1228	        } else {
  1229	            entries.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
  1230	            Some(TablesSection { entries })
  1231	        }
  1232	    };
  1233	
  1234	    // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** persist reference_mode + locale ONLY
  1235	    // when non-default — keeps the TOML minimal for the common A1/EnUs
  1236	    // case. v6→v7 readers see `None` for the default case (interpreted
  1237	    // as A1/EnUs by the loader's default path); the field is only
  1238	    // written when the workbook has been actively set to R1C1 or a
  1239	    // non-EN locale.
  1240	    let reference_mode_wire = match wb.reference_mode() {
  1241	        ql_types::ReferenceMode::A1 => None,
  1242	        mode => Some(ReferenceModeWire::from_runtime(mode)),
  1243	    };
  1244	    let locale_wire = match wb.locale() {
  1245	        ql_types::Locale::EnUs => None,
  1246	        locale => Some(LocaleWire::from_runtime(locale)),
  1247	    };
  1248	
  1249	    let envelope = WorkbookEnvelope {
  1250	        schema_version: WORKBOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION,
  1251	        name: name.to_owned(),
  1252	        sheets: sheet_envelopes,
  1253	        names: names_section,
  1254	        // **W5-71 (Phase 4.5.A.2):** persist the workbook's date system.
  1255	        date_system: Some(DateSystemWire::from_runtime(wb.date_system())),
  1256	        // **W5-81 (Phase 4.5.D part 5):** persist custom format entries.
  1257	        formats: formats_section,
  1258	        // **W5-123 (Phase 4.8.L):** persist workbook tables.
  1259	        tables: tables_section,
  1260	        // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** persist non-default reference_mode + locale.
  1261	        reference_mode: reference_mode_wire,
  1262	        locale: locale_wire,
  1263	    };
  1264	    let toml_str = toml::to_string_pretty(&envelope)?;
  1265	    fs::write(dir.join("workbook.toml"), toml_str)?;
  1266	
  1267	    // Per-sheet JSONL.
  1268	    for sheet_id in 0..(wb.sheet_count() as SheetId) {
  1269	        let sheet = wb.sheet(sheet_id).expect("sheet_count was wrong");
  1270	        let sheet_path = sheets_dir.join(format!("{sheet_id}.jsonl"));
  1271	        let f = fs::File::create(&sheet_path)?;
  1272	        let mut writer = BufWriter::new(f);
  1273	        let bounds = sheet.bounds();
  1274	
  1275	        // Collect formula cells for this sheet so we can emit them even when their
  1276	        // row/col falls outside the value-bounds rectangle (e.g. a formula cell
  1277	        // with no evaluated value yet, or a formula at an extreme position).
  1278	        // Sort by (row, col) for deterministic output.
  1279	        let mut formula_positions: Vec<(RowId, ColId)> = wb
  1280	            .iter_formulas()
  1281	            .filter(|(s, _, _, _)| *s == sheet_id)
  1282	            .map(|(_, r, c, _)| (r, c))
  1283	            .collect();
  1284	        formula_positions.sort();
  1285	
  1286	        // Track which (row, col) pairs we've already written from the value-bounds
  1287	        // sweep, so the formula-only pass doesn't double-emit.
  1288	        let mut written: std::collections::HashSet<(RowId, ColId)> =
  1289	            std::collections::HashSet::new();
  1290	
  1291	        // Naive iteration over value bounds. Sparse cells (Blank without a formula)
  1292	        // are skipped. Phase 2 may optimize via direct chunk-walking; not on hot path.
  1293	        for row in 0..bounds.row_extent {
  1294	            for col in 0..bounds.col_extent {
  1295	                // **W5-105 (Phase 4.7.L) — design § 12.2 closure**: skip
  1296	                // non-anchor spill TARGET cells. Their computed values are
  1297	                // runtime-derived from the anchor's formula via the
  1298	                // load → recompute_all pipeline (Phase 4.7.J #128 made
  1299	                // recompute_all dispatch top-level arrays through
  1300	                // `write_spill`). Saving target cells would emit
  1301	                // `CellRecord { value: <spilled>, formula: None }` records
  1302	                // that on reload look like user-typed values BLOCKING the
  1303	                // re-spill — the very issue Codex W5-94 design HIGH-5
  1304	                // identified as motivating the schema-skip approach.
  1305	                //
  1306	                // The anchor cell itself still saves (its formula text is
  1307	                // what replay + recompute_all needs).
  1308	                if let Some(anchor) = wb.spill_target_anchor(sheet_id, row, col) {
  1309	                    if anchor != (sheet_id, row, col) {
  1310	                        continue;
  1311	                    }
  1312	                }
  1313	
  1314	                let v = sheet.read(row, col);
  1315	                // Audit M6 fix (2026-05-12): reject NaN/Inf at the save boundary.
  1316	                if let Value::Number(n) = v {
  1317	                    if !n.is_finite() {
  1318	                        return Err(QbookError::NonFiniteNumber {
  1319	                            sheet: sheet_id,
  1320	                            row,
  1321	                            col,
  1322	                            value: n,
  1323	                        });
  1324	                    }
  1325	                }
  1326	                let wire = CellWireValue::from_value(&v);
  1327	                let formula = wb
  1328	                    .formula_at(sheet_id, row, col)
  1329	                    .map(|s| s.as_ref().to_owned());
  1330	                // Emit if there's a non-blank value OR a formula.
  1331	                if wire.is_some() || formula.is_some() {
  1332	                    // Phase 2A.8 audit M11: formula-bearing cells with Blank
  1333	                    // saved value encode as `Pending` (was: `Error(#NULL!)`,
  1334	                    // which conflated "not yet evaluated" with a real Excel
  1335	                    // #NULL! error). `Pending` is a distinct wire variant the
  1336	                    // loader recognizes as "recompute required."
  1337	                    let rec = CellRecord {
  1338	                        row,
  1339	                        col,
  1340	                        value: wire.unwrap_or(CellWireValue::Pending),
  1341	                        formula,
  1342	                    };
  1343	                    let line = serde_json::to_string(&rec)?;
  1344	                    writeln!(writer, "{line}")?;
  1345	                    written.insert((row, col));
  1346	                }
  1347	            }
  1348	        }
  1349	
  1350	        // Emit formula cells whose (row, col) fell outside the value-bounds
  1351	        // rectangle. These are formula-only cells with Blank values: encoded
  1352	        // as `Pending` per Phase 2A.8 audit M11 so the formula text survives
  1353	        // round-trip without conflating with a real #NULL! error.
  1354	        for (row, col) in formula_positions {
  1355	            if written.contains(&(row, col)) {
  1356	                continue;
  1357	            }
  1358	            let formula = wb
  1359	                .formula_at(sheet_id, row, col)
  1360	                .map(|s| s.as_ref().to_owned());
  1361	            let rec = CellRecord {
  1362	                row,
  1363	                col,
  1364	                value: CellWireValue::Pending,
  1365	                formula,
  1366	            };
  1367	            let line = serde_json::to_string(&rec)?;
  1368	            writeln!(writer, "{line}")?;
  1369	        }
  1370	        writer.flush()?;
  1371	    }
  1372	
  1373	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H1: write the atomic-save marker LAST, after
  1374	    // envelope + all sheet JSONLs. A partial write that fails before this
  1375	    // point leaves a directory WITHOUT the marker, so recovery won't
  1376	    // mistake the partial result for an engine-owned backup. Marker
  1377	    // content is the schema version + a human-readable note (no parsing —
  1378	    // the filename's presence is the only signal recovery consults).
  1379	    fs::write(
  1380	        dir.join(ATOMIC_SAVE_MARKER_FILENAME),
  1381	        format!(
  1382	            "Quantbook atomic-save marker v1 (schema_version={WORKBOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION}).\n\
  1383	             Presence of this file proves the directory was written by the\n\
  1384	             engine's atomic-save protocol. Used by recover_from_crashed_save\n\
  1385	             to distinguish engine-owned `.bak-<random>` siblings from\n\
  1386	             user-created sibling directories. Safe to ignore.\n"
  1387	        ),
  1388	    )?;
  1389	
  1390	    Ok(())
  1391	}
  1392	
  1393	/// Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H1: a directory is "engine-owned" iff it contains
  1394	/// our marker file. Used by recovery to filter `.bak-<random>` siblings —
  1395	/// user-created directories that match the prefix but lack the marker are
  1396	/// left alone.
  1397	fn is_engine_owned_backup(dir: &Path) -> bool {
  1398	    dir.join(ATOMIC_SAVE_MARKER_FILENAME).is_file()
  1399	}
  1400	
  1401	/// Load a `Workbook` from a `.qbook/` directory.
  1402	///
  1403	/// Phase 2A.8 audit H2: before reading, calls `recover_from_crashed_save` to
  1404	/// detect and resolve orphan `.bak-<random>` siblings left by a prior crashed
  1405	/// save. Recovery either rolls forward (target valid, cleanup orphan) or rolls
  1406	/// back (target missing/invalid, restore orphan).
  1407	pub fn load_workbook(path: &Path) -> Result<Workbook, QbookError> {
  1408	    // Recovery happens BEFORE the directory check — if the prior save crashed
  1409	    // between step 2 (rename → bak) and step 3 (rename temp → target), the
  1410	    // target may not yet exist. Recovery restores it from .bak.
  1411	    recover_from_crashed_save(path)?;
  1412	
  1413	    if !path.is_dir() {
  1414	        return Err(QbookError::NotADirectory {
  1415	            path: path.to_path_buf(),
  1416	        });
  1417	    }
  1418	
  1419	    // Read + parse envelope.
  1420	    let toml_path = path.join("workbook.toml");
  1421	    if !toml_path.is_file() {
  1422	        return Err(QbookError::MissingFile { file: toml_path });
  1423	    }
  1424	    let toml_str = fs::read_to_string(&toml_path)?;
  1425	
  1426	    // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** two-phase load (closes Sonnet H-2).
  1427	    // Phase 1: probe just the schema_version field. This lets a vN
  1428	    // reader reject vN+1 files BEFORE serde encounters the new fields
  1429	    // and trips `deny_unknown_fields` with a less informative
  1430	    // `TomlDe` error. `SchemaVersionProbe` derives `Deserialize`
  1431	    // without `deny_unknown_fields`, so it tolerates extra fields.
  1432	    let probe: SchemaVersionProbe = toml::from_str(&toml_str)?;
  1433	    if probe.schema_version < MIN_SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION
  1434	        || probe.schema_version > WORKBOOK_SCHEMA_VERSION
  1435	    {
  1436	        return Err(QbookError::UnsupportedSchema {
  1437	            found: probe.schema_version,
  1438	        });
  1439	    }
  1440	    let schema_version = probe.schema_version;
  1441	    // Phase 2: full envelope deserialization. Now that we know the
  1442	    // version is in range, `deny_unknown_fields` runs against a
  1443	    // shape that we know matches this build.
  1444	    let envelope: WorkbookEnvelope = toml::from_str(&toml_str)?;
  1445	
  1446	    // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** post-deserialize assertion that v7-only
  1447	    // fields aren't present on a v6-or-older envelope (closes Codex
  1448	    // HIGH-5). serde's `#[serde(default)]` on the new fields means a
  1449	    // hand-edited v6 file with `reference_mode = "R1C1"` would
  1450	    // deserialize cleanly into a Some(_) without the version gate
  1451	    // catching it. We catch it here and refuse loudly.
  1452	    if schema_version < 7 {
  1453	        if envelope.reference_mode.is_some() {
  1454	            return Err(QbookError::ForwardCompatFieldOnOldVersion {
  1455	                schema_version,
  1456	                field: "reference_mode",
  1457	            });
  1458	        }
  1459	        if envelope.locale.is_some() {
  1460	            return Err(QbookError::ForwardCompatFieldOnOldVersion {
  1461	                schema_version,
  1462	                field: "locale",
  1463	            });
  1464	        }
  1465	    }
  1466	
  1467	    // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** apply v7 fields if present. Unknown
  1468	    // locale strings surface as `QbookError::UnknownLocale` (closes
  1469	    // Sonnet M-2) — the custom Deserialize captured the string into
  1470	    // `LocaleWire::Unknown(s)`; `to_runtime()` returns Err(s) here.
  1471	    let reference_mode = envelope
  1472	        .reference_mode
  1473	        .map(|w| w.to_runtime())
  1474	        .unwrap_or(ql_types::ReferenceMode::A1);
  1475	    let locale = match envelope.locale.clone() {
  1476	        Some(w) => w
  1477	            .to_runtime()
  1478	            .map_err(|found| QbookError::UnknownLocale { found })?,
  1479	        None => ql_types::Locale::EnUs,
  1480	    };
  1481	
  1482	    let is_v1 = schema_version == 1;
  1483	
  1484	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H4: counter for legacy-pending migrations so we
  1485	    // can warn the user once per load (rather than silently corrupting any
  1486	    // legitimate `#NULL!` formula results from v1 workbooks).
  1487	    let mut legacy_pending_migrations: usize = 0;
  1488	
  1489	    // Construct the Workbook + sheets in id order. Sheet ids in the envelope must be
  1490	    // sequential 0..N — Workbook::add_sheet allocates ids in that order.
  1491	    // Audit M3 fix (2026-05-12): previously this panicked; now returns Result error.
  1492	    let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  1493	    // **W5-71 (Phase 4.5.A.2):** apply the envelope's date_system, defaulting
  1494	    // to Excel1900 when absent (v1/v2 envelopes lack the field). v3+
  1495	    // envelopes always carry it.
  1496	    if let Some(ds_wire) = envelope.date_system {
  1497	        wb.set_date_system(ds_wire.to_runtime());
  1498	    }
  1499	    // (Else: leave at Workbook::default(), which is Excel1900.)
  1500	    // **W5-145 (Phase 4.9.I):** apply v7 reference_mode + locale.
  1501	    // Defaults already enforced above; setting unconditionally is
  1502	    // a no-op for the default (A1 / EnUs) case.
  1503	    wb.set_reference_mode(reference_mode);
  1504	    wb.set_locale(locale);
  1505	    // **W5-81 (Phase 4.5.D part 5):** apply the envelope's FormatsSection.
  1506	    // v4 envelopes carry custom format entries (id ≥ 164); v1-v3 don't.
  1507	    // Built-ins 0-163 are already in the FormatTable from
  1508	    // `Workbook::default()`. `register_at` is idempotent for the
  1509	    // pre-seeded builtins; mismatches surface as `MalformedFormat`.
  1510	    if let Some(ref fs) = envelope.formats {
  1511	        for entry in &fs.entries {
  1512	            wb.formats_mut()
  1513	                .register_at(ql_storage::FormatId(entry.id), entry.string.as_str())
  1514	                .map_err(|err| QbookError::MalformedFormat {
  1515	                    id: entry.id,
  1516	                    details: format!("{err:?}"),
  1517	                })?;
  1518	        }
  1519	    }
  1520	    let sheets_dir = path.join("sheets");
  1521	    for (expected_id, sheet_env) in envelope.sheets.iter().enumerate() {
  1522	        if sheet_env.id as usize != expected_id {
  1523	            return Err(QbookError::NonSequentialSheetIds {
  1524	                expected: expected_id as u16,
  1525	                found: sheet_env.id,
  1526	            });
  1527	        }
  1528	        // W5-93 (Phase 4.6.E closure): route through the fallible variant
  1529	        // so a malformed `.qbook` (hand-edited duplicate name, reserved
  1530	        // char, empty) surfaces as `QbookError::MalformedSheet` rather
  1531	        // than a process-killing panic. Previously the loader silently
  1532	        // accepted any name.
  1533	        let sheet_id = wb
  1534	            .try_add_sheet_with_chunk_rows(sheet_env.name.clone(), sheet_env.chunk_rows)
  1535	            .map_err(|source| QbookError::MalformedSheet {
  1536	                sheet_id: sheet_env.id,
  1537	                name: sheet_env.name.clone(),
  1538	                source,
  1539	            })?;
  1540	        assert_eq!(
  1541	            sheet_id as usize, expected_id,
  1542	            "Workbook::try_add_sheet_with_chunk_rows returned non-sequential id — programmer error in ql-storage"
  1543	        );
  1544	
  1545	        // **W5-81 (Phase 4.5.D part 5):** apply the per-sheet cell-format
  1546	        // overlay. v4 envelopes carry `format_overlay`; v1-v3 don't.
  1547	        //
  1548	        // **W5-84 closure (Codex MEDIUM-3):** the loader now VALIDATES
  1549	        // that each overlay id resolves in the workbook's `FormatTable`,
  1550	        // matching the runtime + replay contract (which both surface
  1551	        // `UnknownFormatId` / `FormatNotRegistered` on bad ids). A
  1552	        // corrupted `.qbook` binding a cell to an unregistered id no
  1553	        // longer falls through to silent General fallback at render
  1554	        // time — it now surfaces `MalformedFormatOverlay` at load.
  1555	        if let Some(ref overlay_entries) = sheet_env.format_overlay {
  1556	            // Snapshot the set of registered ids BEFORE the overlay
  1557	            // mutation so we don't borrow `wb` twice (mutable on the
  1558	            // sheet + immutable on `wb.formats()`).
  1559	            let known_ids: std::collections::HashSet<u32> =
  1560	                wb.formats().iter().map(|(id, _)| id.0).collect();
  1561	            let sheet_mut = wb.sheet_mut(sheet_id).expect("just-added sheet must exist");
  1562	            for entry in overlay_entries {
  1563	                // Bounds-check to mirror the cell-record validation
  1564	                // below — out-of-range coordinates surface as
  1565	                // `MalformedFormatOverlay` rather than silently binding
  1566	                // a sentinel address.
  1567	                if entry.row > MAX_ROW || entry.col > MAX_COLUMN {
  1568	                    return Err(QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
  1569	                        sheet: sheet_id,
  1570	                        row: entry.row,
  1571	                        col: entry.col,
  1572	                        why: "out-of-range row/col",
  1573	                    });
  1574	                }
  1575	                if !known_ids.contains(&entry.id) {
  1576	                    return Err(QbookError::MalformedFormatOverlay {
  1577	                        sheet: sheet_id,
  1578	                        row: entry.row,
  1579	                        col: entry.col,
  1580	                        why: "format id not registered in FormatTable",
  1581	                    });
  1582	                }
  1583	                sheet_mut.format_overlay_mut().set(
  1584	                    entry.row,
  1585	                    entry.col,
  1586	                    ql_storage::FormatId(entry.id),
  1587	                );
  1588	            }
  1589	        }
  1590	
  1591	        // Audit M2 fix (2026-05-12): a missing sheet JSONL is now an explicit
  1592	        // MissingFile error rather than silently treating the sheet as empty
  1593	        // (which would mask corruption / partial saves). The on-disk format
  1594	        // emits an empty file for an empty sheet, so file-presence is the
  1595	        // correctness oracle.
  1596	        let sheet_path = sheets_dir.join(format!("{sheet_id}.jsonl"));
  1597	        if !sheet_path.is_file() {
  1598	            return Err(QbookError::MissingFile { file: sheet_path });
  1599	        }
  1600	        let f = fs::File::open(&sheet_path)?;
  1601	        let reader = BufReader::new(f);
  1602	        for (line_no, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
  1603	            let line = line?;
  1604	            if line.trim().is_empty() {
  1605	                continue;
  1606	            }
  1607	            let rec: CellRecord =
  1608	                serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| QbookError::MalformedCell {
  1609	                    file: sheet_path.clone(),
  1610	                    line: line_no + 1,
  1611	                    detail: format!("JSON parse: {e}"),
  1612	                })?;
  1613	            // Audit H4 fix (2026-05-12): validate row/col bounds at the loader so
  1614	            // hand-crafted JSONL with out-of-bounds coordinates produces a clean
  1615	            // MalformedCell error instead of panicking inside Sheet::put.
  1616	            if rec.row > MAX_ROW {
  1617	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedCell {
  1618	                    file: sheet_path.clone(),
  1619	                    line: line_no + 1,
  1620	                    detail: format!("row {} exceeds MAX_ROW {MAX_ROW}", rec.row),
  1621	                });
  1622	            }
  1623	            if rec.col > MAX_COLUMN {
  1624	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedCell {
  1625	                    file: sheet_path.clone(),
  1626	                    line: line_no + 1,
  1627	                    detail: format!("col {} exceeds MAX_COLUMN {MAX_COLUMN}", rec.col),
  1628	                });
  1629	            }
  1630	            // Phase 2A.8 audit M11: detect the v1 legacy encoding of a
  1631	            // formula-bearing Blank cell (`Error("#NULL!")` + formula) and
  1632	            // rewrite it to the v2 Pending semantic during the v1 load path.
  1633	            // v2 files emit `Pending` directly and skip this branch.
  1634	            //
  1635	            // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H4: this rule cannot distinguish
  1636	            // "engine wrote #NULL! as Pending stand-in" from "user's formula
  1637	            // legitimately evaluated to #NULL!" (Excel's intersection-of-
  1638	            // disjoint-ranges error, e.g. `=SUM(A1 B1)` with a space). Both
  1639	            // encode identically in v1. We count migrations and warn ONCE
  1640	            // per load at the end so the user can audit suspect formulas
  1641	            // rather than silently corrupting real #NULL! results.
  1642	            let is_legacy_pending = is_v1
  1643	                && rec.formula.is_some()
  1644	                && matches!(&rec.value, CellWireValue::Error(s) if s == "#NULL!");
  1645	            if is_legacy_pending {
  1646	                legacy_pending_migrations += 1;
  1647	            }
  1648	
  1649	            let value = if rec.value.is_pending() || is_legacy_pending {
  1650	                // Pending cells contribute no Value to the cell — leave it
  1651	                // Blank until recompute runs. The formula text below is what
  1652	                // matters for the recompute pass.
  1653	                Value::Blank
  1654	            } else {
  1655	                // Tier D2 (2026-05-19): `to_value()` now returns
  1656	                // `WireDecodeError`. Attach the qbook-specific
  1657	                // file/line context as `QbookError::MalformedCell` so
  1658	                // load-failure diagnostics keep the same shape.
  1659	                rec.value
  1660	                    .to_value()
  1661	                    .map_err(|e| QbookError::MalformedCell {
  1662	                        file: sheet_path.clone(),
  1663	                        line: line_no + 1,
  1664	                        detail: e.to_string(),
  1665	                    })?
  1666	            };
  1667	            // Phase 3.5 (CORR-25, 2026-05-12) — OVR-3-03: load routes
  1668	            // cells with formulas to the COMPUTED overlay; cells without
  1669	            // formulas go to the USER overlay. This preserves the
  1670	            // engine's semantic invariant ("formula-owned cell has no
  1671	            // user-overlay entry"). Pending/Blank values are skipped on
  1672	            // the formula path because there's nothing to display until
  1673	            // recompute runs; the formula text alone is enough to drive
  1674	            // the recompute pass.
  1675	            let row = rec.row as RowId;
  1676	            let col = rec.col as ColId;
  1677	            if let Some(formula_text) = rec.formula {
  1678	                wb.put_formula(sheet_id, row, col, formula_text);
  1679	                if !matches!(value, Value::Blank) {
  1680	                    wb.put_computed_at(sheet_id, row, col, value);
  1681	                }
  1682	            } else {
  1683	                wb.put_at(sheet_id, row, col, value);
  1684	            }
  1685	        }
  1686	    }
  1687	
  1688	    // Phase 2A.8: hydrate the workbook's NameTable from the envelope's
  1689	    // `names` section. v1 envelopes lack the section (envelope.names is None);
  1690	    // those workbooks load with an empty NameTable, matching prior behavior.
  1691	    //
  1692	    // Phase 2A.9 audit M6: `Workbook::set_name` may now refuse reserved names
  1693	    // (currently `AI` per CORR-06). A v2 file that somehow contains a reserved
  1694	    // name (e.g., hand-edited TOML) surfaces as `QbookError::MalformedName`.
  1695	    // **W5-92 (Phase 4.6.D):** route by scope. `scope: None` (the v1-v4
  1696	    // historical case) lands in the workbook-scoped `NameTable`;
  1697	    // `scope: Some(id)` lands in that sheet's `scoped_names` table. An
  1698	    // unknown sheet id surfaces as `MalformedName` (the load-time
  1699	    // analog of the op-log replay's `InvalidSheet` — we can't carry the
  1700	    // structural error through `QbookError`'s vocabulary without a new
  1701	    // variant, and `MalformedName` is the right shape for "name's
  1702	    // target is bad").
  1703	    if let Some(names_section) = envelope.names {
  1704	        for entry in names_section.entries {
  1705	            let target = entry.target.to_target(&entry.name)?;
  1706	            match entry.scope {
  1707	                None => {
  1708	                    wb.set_name(&entry.name, target)
  1709	                        .map_err(|e| QbookError::MalformedName {
  1710	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1711	                            reason: format!("rejected by workbook NameTable: {e}"),
  1712	                        })?;
  1713	                }
  1714	                Some(sheet_id) => {
  1715	                    let sheet =
  1716	                        wb.sheet_mut(sheet_id)
  1717	                            .ok_or_else(|| QbookError::MalformedName {
  1718	                                name: entry.name.clone(),
  1719	                                reason: format!("scope refers to unknown sheet id {sheet_id}"),
  1720	                            })?;
  1721	                    sheet.set_scoped_name(&entry.name, target).map_err(|e| {
  1722	                        QbookError::MalformedName {
  1723	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1724	                            reason: format!("rejected by sheet {sheet_id} NameTable: {e}"),
  1725	                        }
  1726	                    })?;
  1727	                }
  1728	            }
  1729	        }
  1730	    }
  1731	
  1732	    // **W5-123 (Phase 4.8.L):** hydrate `TableTable` from the envelope's
  1733	    // `tables` section. v6+ envelopes carry the section; v1-v5 don't,
  1734	    // so a `None` envelope tables field is the regression-neutral path
  1735	    // (loader leaves `TableTable::default()`).
  1736	    //
  1737	    // Direct `tables_mut().insert(...)` bypasses `WorkbookRuntime::
  1738	    // create_table` validation; that's the intentional loader pattern
  1739	    // (matches how `Workbook::add_sheet` etc. are called bypassing
  1740	    // op-log emission). Per design § 4.3 invariants 1-4 the persisted
  1741	    // shape is already legal (it was validated at create / resize
  1742	    // time on a prior session). We do enforce structural shape
  1743	    // (non-zero dims, columns length matches cols, sheet id exists)
  1744	    // so a corrupted / hand-edited TOML surfaces `MalformedTable`
  1745	    // rather than panicking downstream.
  1746	    if let Some(tables_section) = envelope.tables {
  1747	        for entry in tables_section.entries {
  1748	            if wb.sheet(entry.sheet).is_none() {
  1749	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1750	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1751	                    reason: format!("references unknown sheet id {}", entry.sheet),
  1752	                });
  1753	            }
  1754	            if entry.rows == 0 || entry.cols == 0 {
  1755	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1756	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1757	                    reason: "table rows and cols must both be > 0".into(),
  1758	                });
  1759	            }
  1760	            // **W5-125 (Phase 4.8.O.1 — Codex HIGH-1):** validate
  1761	            // footprint upper bound mirrors producer + replay. A hand-
  1762	            // edited / corrupted TOML with `top_row + rows - 1 > MAX_ROW`
  1763	            // would otherwise let a table register cells beyond the
  1764	            // addressable grid, and a u32-overflowing footprint would
  1765	            // skip downstream checks.
  1766	            if let Err(reason) = ql_storage::TableMetadata::validate_footprint_bounds(
  1767	                entry.top_row,
  1768	                entry.top_col,
  1769	                entry.rows,
  1770	                entry.cols,
  1771	            ) {
  1772	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1773	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1774	                    reason: reason.to_owned(),
  1775	                });
  1776	            }
  1777	            if entry.columns.len() != entry.cols as usize {
  1778	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1779	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1780	                    reason: format!(
  1781	                        "columns length {} does not match cols {}",
  1782	                        entry.columns.len(),
  1783	                        entry.cols
  1784	                    ),
  1785	                });
  1786	            }
  1787	            // **W5-126 (Phase 4.8.O.2 — Codex MEDIUM-1):** re-validate
  1788	            // the runtime registry invariants at load time. The W5-123
  1789	            // docstring said "loader trusts the file" — Codex flagged
  1790	            // that a hand-edited / corrupted v6 TOML could enter the
  1791	            // engine with state that runtime mutation wouldn't allow.
  1792	            // Concrete failure modes: silent duplicate-name overwrite
  1793	            // (leaks column ids into the allocator); namespace
  1794	            // collision with NameTable; overlapping table footprints
  1795	            // (HashMap-order indeterminism in `Workbook::table_at`);
  1796	            // duplicate or empty column names breaking `lookup_column`.
  1797	            let canonical_upper = entry.name.to_ascii_uppercase();
  1798	            // Name uniqueness against already-loaded tables (catches
  1799	            // duplicate canonical names within the same TablesSection
  1800	            // entries vec, since each insert lands in `wb.tables_mut()`
  1801	            // before the next iteration).
  1802	            if wb.tables().lookup(&canonical_upper).is_some() {
  1803	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1804	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1805	                    reason: "duplicate canonical table name in [[tables.entries]]".into(),
  1806	                });
  1807	            }
  1808	            // Shared namespace with NameTable. NameTable hydration ran
  1809	            // above; workbook-scoped conflicts are checked here via
  1810	            // `lookup_ci`. **Sheet-scoped name collisions are
  1811	            // intentionally NOT checked** — `WorkbookRuntime::create_table`
  1812	            // also only checks workbook-scoped names, so loader and
  1813	            // runtime are consistent (design § 13 #3: sheet-scoped
  1814	            // names shadow workbook-scoped within their sheet, and
  1815	            // tables are workbook-scoped, so the binder resolves them
  1816	            // from separate paths). Closing this is a wider design
  1817	            // change that belongs to a future polish wave, not the
  1818	            // loader.
  1819	            if wb.names().lookup_ci(&canonical_upper).is_some() {
  1820	                return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1821	                    name: entry.name.clone(),
  1822	                    reason: "table name collides with a workbook-scoped defined name".into(),
  1823	                });
  1824	            }
  1825	            // Column-level shape: non-empty `name` AND `display`,
  1826	            // unique canonical (lowercase) names, no `u32::MAX`
  1827	            // column ids (closes Codex MEDIUM-2 — `TableTable::insert`
  1828	            // does unchecked `max_id + 1` on the column-id allocator).
  1829	            {
  1830	                use std::collections::HashSet;
  1831	                let mut seen_canon: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
  1832	                for col in &entry.columns {
  1833	                    if col.name.is_empty() || col.display.is_empty() {
  1834	                        return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1835	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1836	                            reason: "table column names cannot be empty".into(),
  1837	                        });
  1838	                    }
  1839	                    if col.id == u32::MAX {
  1840	                        return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1841	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1842	                            reason: "column id cannot be u32::MAX (would overflow allocator)"
  1843	                                .into(),
  1844	                        });
  1845	                    }
  1846	                    if !seen_canon.insert(col.name.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
  1847	                        return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1848	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1849	                            reason: "duplicate canonical column name within table".into(),
  1850	                        });
  1851	                    }
  1852	                }
  1853	            }
  1854	            // Footprint non-overlap against tables already inserted in
  1855	            // earlier loop iterations.
  1856	            for r in entry.top_row..entry.top_row + entry.rows {
  1857	                for c in entry.top_col..entry.top_col + entry.cols {
  1858	                    if wb.table_at(entry.sheet, r, c).is_some() {
  1859	                        return Err(QbookError::MalformedTable {
  1860	                            name: entry.name.clone(),
  1861	                            reason: "table footprint overlaps a previously loaded table".into(),
  1862	                        });
  1863	                    }
  1864	                }
  1865	            }
  1866	            // **W5-128 (Phase 4.8.O.4 — Codex closure-verify MEDIUM-1 second-pass):**
  1867	            // insert under the UPPERCASE canonical, not the raw
  1868	            // `entry.name`. Engine-saved files always have uppercase
  1869	            // `entry.name`, but a hand-edited TOML with mixed-case
  1870	            // (`name = "Sales"`) would otherwise enter the HashMap
  1871	            // under key "Sales" while `TableTable::lookup` uppercases
  1872	            // every query — silently making the table unfindable.
  1873	            // The new pin in `load_normalizes_mixed_case_table_name`
  1874	            // catches the regression at boundary cases the W5-126
  1875	            // tests missed (those used identical uppercase names).
  1876	            let canonical: std::sync::Arc<str> = std::sync::Arc::from(canonical_upper.as_str());
  1877	            let columns: Vec<ql_storage::TableColumn> = entry
  1878	                .columns
  1879	                .into_iter()
  1880	                .map(|c| ql_storage::TableColumn {
  1881	                    id: c.id,
  1882	                    name: std::sync::Arc::from(c.name.as_str()),
  1883	                    display: std::sync::Arc::from(c.display.as_str()),
  1884	                    totals_function: c.totals_function.map(TotalsFunctionWire::to_runtime),
  1885	                })
  1886	                .collect();
  1887	            let meta = ql_storage::TableMetadata {
  1888	                name: std::sync::Arc::clone(&canonical),
  1889	                display_name: std::sync::Arc::from(entry.display_name.as_str()),
  1890	                sheet: entry.sheet,
  1891	                top_row: entry.top_row,
  1892	                top_col: entry.top_col,
  1893	                rows: entry.rows,
  1894	                cols: entry.cols,
  1895	                has_header: entry.has_header,
  1896	                has_totals: entry.has_totals,
  1897	                columns,
  1898	            };
  1899	            // `insert` auto-bumps `next_column_id` past any persisted
  1900	            // column id (added in 4.8.L to keep the loader-side ids
  1901	            // collision-free with future runtime allocations).
  1902	            wb.tables_mut().insert(canonical, meta);
  1903	        }
  1904	    }
  1905	
  1906	    // Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H4: warn once per load if we rewrote any v1
  1907	    // `Error("#NULL!") + formula` cells to Pending. The rewrite is correct
  1908	    // for engine-produced files (where #NULL! was a stand-in for "not yet
  1909	    // evaluated") but COULD silently corrupt legitimate Excel #NULL! results
  1910	    // — the v1 wire format conflated both cases. The user should re-check
  1911	    // any formulas that legitimately produce #NULL! after this load.
  1912	    if legacy_pending_migrations > 0 {
  1913	        eprintln!(
  1914	            "warning: load_workbook {path:?} migrated {legacy_pending_migrations} v1 \
  1915	             `Error(#NULL!) + formula` cells to the v2 Pending semantic. \
  1916	             If any of those formulas were authored to produce #NULL! intentionally \
  1917	             (e.g. `=SUM(A1 B1)` with a space), their evaluated values will be lost \
  1918	             until recompute. Re-save the workbook in v2 format to remove this ambiguity."
  1919	        );
  1920	    }
  1921	
  1922	    Ok(wb)
  1923	}

  1925	/// Read the actual `chunk_rows` from a sheet. Audit H5 fix (2026-05-12): uses the
  1926	/// `Sheet::chunk_rows()` accessor (added in W5-7) so the envelope reflects the
  1927	/// real layout instead of the env default.
  1928	fn sheet_chunk_rows(sheet: &Sheet) -> u32 {
  1929	    sheet.chunk_rows()
  1930	}

  1950	    fn wb_with(name: &str, cells: &[((SheetId, RowId, ColId), Value)]) -> Workbook {
  1951	        let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  1952	        let sheet_id = wb.add_sheet(name);
  1953	        for ((_s, r, c), v) in cells {
  1954	            wb.put_at(sheet_id, *r, *c, v.clone());

  2123	    #[test]
  2124	    fn malformed_jsonl_errors() {
  2125	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  2126	        let path = dir.path().join("bad.qbook");

  2354	    /// Audit M6 fix (2026-05-12): file-level NaN handling. serde_json silently
  2355	    /// encodes NaN as `null`, producing files that fail to load — a silent
  2356	    /// corruption. Save-side validation rejects NaN/Inf explicitly with a
  2357	    /// NonFiniteNumber error carrying the cell coordinates.
  2358	    #[test]
  2359	    fn save_with_nan_value_errors_cleanly() {
  2360	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  2361	        let path = dir.path().join("nan-save.qbook");
  2362	
  2363	        let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  2364	        let sheet_id = wb.add_sheet("S");
  2365	        // Bypass Value::number sanitizer by using the pub enum variant directly.
  2366	        wb.put_at(sheet_id, 5, 3, Value::Number(f64::NAN));
  2367	
  2368	        match save_workbook(&wb, "nan-test", &path) {
  2369	            Err(QbookError::NonFiniteNumber {
  2370	                sheet,
  2371	                row,
  2372	                col,
  2373	                value,
  2374	            }) => {
  2375	                assert_eq!(sheet, sheet_id);
  2376	                assert_eq!(row, 5);
  2377	                assert_eq!(col, 3);
  2378	                assert!(value.is_nan());
  2379	            }
  2380	            other => panic!("expected NonFiniteNumber error, got {other:?}"),
  2381	        }
  2382	        // After a failed save, the target should NOT exist (atomic-save guarantee).
  2383	        assert!(
  2384	            !path.exists(),
  2385	            "atomic-save invariant violated: target exists after failed save at {path:?}"
  2386	        );
  2387	    }

  2426	    /// W5-9: formula cells survive save → load round-trip with both the formula text
  2427	    /// AND the evaluated value preserved.
  2428	    #[test]
  2429	    fn roundtrip_formula_with_value() {

  2438	        wb.put_at(s, 1, 0, Value::Number(15.0));
  2439	        wb.put_formula(s, 1, 0, "A1 * 3");
  2440	
  2441	        save_workbook(&wb, "formulas", &path).unwrap();
  2442	        let loaded = load_workbook(&path).unwrap();

  2447	        // Formula cell.
  2448	        assert_eq!(loaded.sheet(s).unwrap().read(1, 0), Value::Number(15.0));
  2449	        assert_eq!(
  2450	            loaded.formula_at(s, 1, 0).map(|s| s.as_ref()),
  2451	            Some("A1 * 3")
  2452	        );
  2453	    }

  2539	    /// Audit M4 acceptance (2026-05-12): a successful save replaces the target
  2540	    /// atomically via a sibling temp dir + rename. No temp leftover after success.
  2541	    #[test]
  2542	    fn atomic_save_leaves_no_temp_or_backup_after_success() {
  2543	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  2544	        let path = dir.path().join("atomic.qbook");
  2545	        let wb = wb_with("S", &[cell(0, 0, Value::Number(1.0))]);
  2546	        save_workbook(&wb, "atomic-test", &path).unwrap();
  2547	        assert!(path.exists(), "target should exist after save");
  2548	
  2549	        // Phase 2A.8: after a successful save, neither `<base>.tmp-save-*`
  2550	        // nor `<base>.bak-*` sibling should remain.
  2551	        let basename = path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
  2552	        let parent = path.parent().unwrap();
  2553	        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(parent).unwrap().flatten() {
  2554	            let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
  2555	            assert!(
  2556	                !name.starts_with(&format!("{basename}.tmp-save-")),
  2557	                "found leftover temp sibling: {name}"
  2558	            );
  2559	            assert!(
  2560	                !name.starts_with(&format!("{basename}.bak-")),
  2561	                "found leftover backup sibling: {name}"
  2562	            );
  2563	        }
  2564	    }

  2566	    /// Phase 2A.8 (was Audit M4): a failed save does NOT clobber the existing
  2567	    /// target. Pre-populate target with one workbook, then attempt to save a
  2568	    /// NaN-bearing workbook (which the save-side NaN guard will reject). The
  2569	    /// pre-existing target must remain readable and unchanged.
  2570	    #[test]
  2571	    fn failed_save_does_not_clobber_target() {
  2572	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  2573	        let path = dir.path().join("preserved.qbook");
  2574	
  2575	        // First, write a valid workbook with known content.
  2576	        let original = wb_with("S", &[cell(0, 0, Value::Number(42.0))]);
  2577	        save_workbook(&original, "first", &path).unwrap();
  2578	        assert!(path.exists());
  2579	
  2580	        // Attempt a save that will fail (NaN-bearing).
  2581	        let mut bad_wb = Workbook::new();
  2582	        let sheet_id = bad_wb.add_sheet("S");
  2583	        bad_wb.put_at(sheet_id, 0, 0, Value::Number(f64::NAN));
  2584	        let result = save_workbook(&bad_wb, "bad", &path);
  2585	        assert!(result.is_err(), "expected save to fail");
  2586	
  2587	        // Target must still exist with the original content.
  2588	        assert!(path.exists(), "target was clobbered by failed save");
  2589	        let reloaded = load_workbook(&path).unwrap();
  2590	        assert_eq!(reloaded.sheet(0).unwrap().read(0, 0), Value::Number(42.0));
  2591	
  2592	        // No orphan temp/backup siblings.
  2593	        let basename = path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
  2594	        let parent = path.parent().unwrap();
  2595	        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(parent).unwrap().flatten() {
  2596	            let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().into_owned();
  2597	            assert!(

  2605	    /// Phase 2A.8 audit H2 recovery test — roll-forward case. Simulate a
  2606	    /// crash after step 3 (rename temp → target succeeded) but before step 4
  2607	    /// (backup cleanup): an orphan `.bak-*` sibling exists, AND the target is
  2608	    /// a valid workbook. Recovery should clean up the orphan and load the
  2609	    /// target normally.
  2610	    ///
  2611	    /// Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H1 update: the orphan also needs the
  2612	    /// `.atomic-save-marker-v1` file inside it; otherwise recovery treats it
  2613	    /// as a user-created sibling and leaves it alone.
  2614	    #[test]
  2615	    fn load_recovers_orphan_backup_when_target_valid_roll_forward() {
  2616	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  2617	        let path = dir.path().join("rollforward.qbook");
  2618	        let wb = wb_with("S", &[cell(0, 0, Value::Number(7.0))]);
  2619	        save_workbook(&wb, "rollforward", &path).unwrap();
  2620	
  2621	        // Manually create an orphan .bak-* sibling alongside the (valid)
  2622	        // target. Loader should detect and remove it.
  2623	        let bak = path.parent().unwrap().join(format!(
  2624	            "{}.bak-deadbeef",
  2625	            path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy()
  2626	        ));
  2627	        fs::create_dir_all(&bak).unwrap();
  2628	        fs::write(bak.join("workbook.toml"), "garbage that won't parse").unwrap();
  2629	        // H1: mark this orphan as engine-owned so recovery acts on it.
  2630	        fs::write(bak.join(ATOMIC_SAVE_MARKER_FILENAME), "engine-owned").unwrap();
  2631	        assert!(bak.exists());
  2632	
  2633	        // Load: should succeed AND clean up the orphan.
  2634	        let loaded = load_workbook(&path).unwrap();
  2635	        assert_eq!(loaded.sheet(0).unwrap().read(0, 0), Value::Number(7.0));
  2636	        assert!(!bak.exists(), "load should have cleaned up the orphan .bak");
  2637	    }

  2639	    /// Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 H1: a user-created sibling directory whose

  2641	    /// recovery must leave it alone. Closes the megaudit's `book.qbook.bak-
  2642	    /// 2025-review` data-loss vector.
  2643	    #[test]
  2644	    fn load_does_not_touch_user_created_sibling_lacking_marker() {
  2645	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();

  2649	
  2650	        // Plant a user-created sibling matching the .bak-* prefix but
  2651	        // lacking the engine marker. Could be a manual backup the user
  2652	        // made, e.g. `mybook.qbook.bak-2025-review/`.
  2653	        let user_sibling = path.parent().unwrap().join(format!(
  2654	            "{}.bak-2025-review",
  2655	            path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy()
  2656	        ));
  2657	        fs::create_dir_all(&user_sibling).unwrap();
  2658	        fs::write(user_sibling.join("notes.md"), "my own backup, don't touch").unwrap();
  2659	        assert!(!is_engine_owned_backup(&user_sibling));

  2670	            "my own backup, don't touch"
  2671	        );

  2701	    /// Phase 2A.13 audit cycle-3 M6: multiple orphan `.bak-*` siblings WITH a
  2702	    /// valid target are all stale (the most-recent successful save left a
  2703	    /// valid target; any older backups failed step-4 cleanup). Clean them
  2704	    /// all up; the load succeeds. Previously refused with InvalidPath,
  2705	    /// creating a permanent deadlock under repeated step-4 failures.
  2706	    #[test]
  2707	    fn load_cleans_all_orphans_when_target_valid_post_2a13() {
  2708	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();

  2716	        let baks: Vec<_> = ["aaa", "bbb"]
  2717	            .iter()

  2723	            })
  2724	            .collect();

  3025	    #[test]
  3026	    fn full_format_round_trip_custom_id_plus_overlay() {
  3027	        // Real-world path: intern a custom format, bind a cell to it,
  3028	        // round-trip, verify everything survives.
  3029	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  3030	        let path = dir.path().join("full.qbook");
  3031	        let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  3032	        let s = wb.add_sheet("Sheet1");
  3033	        let fmt = "\"$\"#,##0.00;[Red]\"$\"#,##0.00"; // V1 parser doesn't
  3034	                                                      // support [Red] but the parser refuses LATE; the FormatTable doesn't
  3035	                                                      // call the parser at registration — it just interns the string.
  3036	                                                      // Use a parser-friendly format here for symmetry with future tests.
  3037	        let _ = fmt; // silence unused
  3038	        let id = wb.formats_mut().intern("\"€\" #,##0.00");

  3043	        assert_eq!(loaded_id, id);

  3205	    /// Phase 2A.8 audit M11: a formula-bearing cell with Blank value
  3206	    /// round-trips through the new `Pending` wire variant. On load, the
  3207	    /// formula is preserved and the cell value is Blank (Pending decodes to
  3208	    /// Blank); recompute would resolve it.
  3209	    #[test]
  3210	    fn formula_only_cell_round_trips_as_pending() {
  3211	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  3212	        let path = dir.path().join("pending.qbook");
  3213	
  3214	        let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  3215	        let s = wb.add_sheet("S");
  3216	        // Cell with a formula but no evaluated value yet (Value::Blank).
  3217	        wb.put_formula(s, 5, 3, "1 + 1");
  3218	        save_workbook(&wb, "pending", &path).unwrap();
  3219	
  3220	        let loaded = load_workbook(&path).unwrap();

  3222	            loaded.formula_at(s, 5, 3).map(|s| s.as_ref()),
  3223	            Some("1 + 1")
  3224	        );
  3225	        // Pending decodes to Blank — recompute would resolve to 2.0.
  3226	        assert_eq!(loaded.read(Address::new(s, 5, 3)), Value::Blank);
  3227	    }

  3229	    /// **W5-105 (Phase 4.7.L)**: spill TARGET cells must NOT be saved
  3230	    /// — only the anchor cell (with its formula text) round-trips.
  3231	    /// Verified by reading the saved sheet JSONL directly: target rows
  3232	    /// for B1/C1 are absent; A1's record has the formula text and a
  3233	    /// Pending value placeholder.
  3234	    #[test]
  3235	    fn spill_target_cells_skipped_on_save() {
  3236	        let dir = TempDir::new().unwrap();
  3237	        let path = dir.path().join("spill-skip.qbook");
  3238	
  3239	        let mut wb = Workbook::new();
  3240	        let s = wb.add_sheet("S");
  3241	        // Simulate the post-set_formula state for `A1 = {1, 2, 3}`:
  3242	        //   - Formula text at A1.
  3243	        //   - Computed values at A1=1, B1=2, C1=3.
  3244	        //   - Spill anchor registered with shape (1, 3).
  3245	        wb.put_formula(s, 0, 0, "{1, 2, 3}");
  3246	        wb.put_computed_at(s, 0, 0, Value::Number(1.0));
  3247	        wb.put_computed_at(s, 0, 1, Value::Number(2.0));
  3248	        wb.put_computed_at(s, 0, 2, Value::Number(3.0));
  3249	        wb.register_spill((s, 0, 0), ql_storage::SpillShape::new(1, 3))
  3250	            .unwrap();
  3251	
  3252	        save_workbook(&wb, "spill-skip", &path).unwrap();
  3253	
  3254	        // Read the saved sheet JSONL directly to confirm B1/C1 are NOT
  3255	        // recorded.
  3256	        let sheet_path = path.join("sheets").join(format!("{s}.jsonl"));
  3257	        let content = fs::read_to_string(&sheet_path).unwrap();
  3258	        // Anchor A1 record must be present.
  3259	        assert!(
  3260	            content.lines().any(|l| {
  3261	                let r: CellRecord = serde_json::from_str(l).unwrap();
  3262	                r.row == 0 && r.col == 0 && r.formula.is_some()
  3263	            }),
  3264	            "anchor A1 record must be present with formula text. got:\n{content}"
  3265	        );
  3266	        // B1 and C1 records must be ABSENT.
  3267	        for (row, col, name) in [(0, 1, "B1"), (0, 2, "C1")] {
  3268	            assert!(
  3269	                content.lines().all(|l| {
  3270	                    let r: CellRecord = serde_json::from_str(l).unwrap();
  3271	                    !(r.row == row && r.col == col)
  3272	                }),
  3273	                "{name} record must NOT appear in saved JSONL (spill target). got:\n{content}"
  3274	            );
  3275	        }
  3276	    }
